summary: Bug fix in the machine-based post-processor: the P word on G4 and canned-cycle commands is now formatted as a dwell time in seconds instead of being divided by 25.4 on imperial output, with format_parameter() gaining an optional, backward-compatible command_name argument.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: format_parameter() gains an optional third argument command_name with default None; two-argument callers keep working, and the page's hook/pipeline sections do not describe the P formatter's unit behaviour
Path/Post/Processor.py: format_p_param restores the documented meaning of a dwell as seconds on imperial output; no dialog, property, or output option changes
Path/Post/Processor.py: internal P-word formatting fix; no new property, argument, or machine output option
Constants.py: new GCODE_P_IS_DWELL list is an internal constant and the G-code reference already treats G4/canned-cycle P as a time

meta.title: CAM: don't unit convert the dwell time on imperial output
